title: Pulmonary TB in HIV — new HIV diagnosis, known HIV not on ART, or ART defaulter (adult)
population: Adult and adolescent ≥ 15 y living with HIV and drug-susceptible PTB; excludes RR-TB, TBM, cryptococcal meningitis
dagger_note: † = clinical or local addition, not in the SA guideline
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, k=kind (check|value|yn|info|sub), h=heading

admission.title: Not this pathway — these have their own pathways

items.t: TB meningitis / cryptococcal meningitis → REFER (ART timing differs)

admission.title: Diagnostic criteria — any one starts TB treatment

items.t: Xpert Ultra positive, Rif susceptible (sputum or other sample)
Urine LF-LAM positive (seriously ill, or CD4 ≤ 200 + TB features)
Xpert negative, TB features: culture + CXR; empiric TB treatment while awaiting culture
Seriously ill, no response to broad-spectrum antibiotics by ~day 3: empiric TB treatment

admission.title: Seriously ill (admit) = any one of — all TB-HIV = advanced HIV

items.t: Advanced HIV: CD4 ≤ 200 or WHO stage 3/4 (TB = stage 3)
Hb < 8 g/dL with no clear cause
HIV status: new · known not on ART · defaulted
Cough · fever · night sweats · weight loss
Why stopped: side effects · access · adherence

admission.title: Vitals and measurements
admission.note: Abnormal = outside adult norms or the patient's documented baseline

items.t: Do U-LAM in every symptomatic PLHIV admitted
Positive = TB: start TB treatment today
Negative does not exclude TB: Xpert + culture

admission.title: CD4 count (+ reflex CrAg) — send on arrival

items.t: < 50: ART within 2 weeks of TB treatment
≥ 50: ART 8 weeks after TB treatment starts
< 200: reflex CrAg; CrAg positive → LP for all (REFER if LP not possible)

admission.title: Red flags to rule out on arrival

decision.t: 10. RR-TB, TB / cryptococcal meningitis, respiratory failure, or on ATV/r or DRV/r without expert plan → REFER / hotline
11. ADMIT = seriously ill PLHIV with TB → start TB treatment + CPT; ART by CD4 (or continue + boost DTG)

chart.phase_note: TB treatment first · ART timing by CD4 (< 50 within 2 weeks) · if already on ART never interrupt · branch rows by HIV group

standing.t: Vitals incl. SpO₂ 4-hourly; hourly while danger signs present
TB dose + ART + extra DTG 12 h later + cotrimoxazole: each dose observed and recorded
Daily: nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, jaundice, rash, tingling, visual change
After ART start: new fever, enlarging nodes, worsening chest (IRIS)
Headache, confusion, neck stiffness (cryptococcal / TB meningitis)
Weight on admission and weekly; dose band re-checked

rows.label: Day 1
rows.lead: Tick HIV group: new · known not on ART · defaulted · on ART. Check the clinic for a TB card or ART script already open†.

tests.t: Culture if Xpert negative or previous TB
Creatinine / eGFR · Hb (FBC if low) · HBsAg

treatment.t: Broad-spectrum parenteral antibiotic (see LRTI adult)
Then RH daily × 4 months: 30–37 kg RH 150/75 × 2 · 38–54 kg × 3 · ≥ 55 kg RH 300/150 × 2
Once daily, 7 days a week; whole daily dose at once
Pyridoxine 25 mg daily for all adults on TB treatment
Cotrimoxazole 960 mg (160/800) daily — all HIV + TB, regardless of CD4
New / defaulted: timing by CD4
On ART: continue, boost DTG
Notify TB; open TB card; record on ART card

tests.t: Chase Xpert, LAM, CD4, CrAg, eGFR

treatment.t: Rif resistant: REFER DR-TB unit
CrAg positive: LP (REFER if not possible)
Record CD4 → tick ART start in patient box
Counsel TB + HIV together
Xpert / LAM negative, not responding to antibiotics: empiric TB treatment
Interstitial infiltrates: treat PJP (LRTI adult)
Not responding to TB treatment by ~5 days: work up fungi, other causes — REFER

tests.t: Baseline: CD4, eGFR, Hb, HBsAg, CrAg

treatment.t: CD4 < 50: start ART within 2 weeks of TB treatment, once improving and tolerating
CD4 ≥ 50: start ART 8 weeks after TB treatment starts
Pregnant / breastfeeding: within 2 weeks
TLD 1 tab daily + DTG 50 mg 12 h later (DTG boosting on rifampicin)
eGFR ≤ 50: ABC + 3TC + DTG (ALD) instead of TLD, + DTG 50 mg 12 h later
ART literacy / fast-track counselling before start
Returning after missed appointment + TB = clinically unwell: follow TB / ART guidelines
Re-initiate a DTG regimen (switch to TLD); timing as for ART-naïve (CD4)
CD4 count to identify AHD
Adherence counselling (EAC) if barriers
VL 3 months after re-engagement

tests.t: VL; CD4 if VL not suppressed

treatment.t: Already on ART: do NOT interrupt
On TLD / DTG: add DTG 50 mg 12 h after TLD
On EFV and suppressed: continue EFV until 2 weeks after TB treatment, then switch to DTG
On LPV/r: double-dose tablets
On ATV/r or DRV/r: rifampicin cannot be given — HIV & TB hotline 0800 212 506
Improving and tolerating TB drugs: start ART now if CD4 < 50 or pregnant
CD4 ≤ 100 and < 30 days of TB treatment when ART starts: prednisone 40 mg daily × 2 weeks, then 20 mg × 2 weeks (not if Kaposi sarcoma)
CD4 ≥ 50: book ART start at week 8 (date on card)
Paradoxical IRIS: continue TB drugs and ART; exclude RR-TB, non-adherence, new OI
Paracetamol 0.5–1 g 4–6-hourly or ibuprofen 400 mg 8-hourly
Severe (compression, CNS): prednisone 1.5 mg/kg daily × 2 weeks, then 0.75 mg/kg × 2 weeks
Aspirate nodes / effusions

feed.t: Stop ART, CPT, R, H, Z

tests.t: ALT + bilirubin every 2 days; hepatitis screen, INR

treatment.t: Background: linezolid 600 mg + levofloxacin 750–1000 mg (or moxifloxacin 400 mg) + ethambutol 800–1200 mg daily
ALT + bilirubin every 2 days (inpatient); hepatitis A/B/C screen, INR
ALT < 100 and bilirubin < 2 × ULN: rifampicin 600 mg (450 mg if < 60 kg) day 1 → ALT day 3 → add INH 300 mg day 4–6 → ALT day 7 → stop FQ + linezolid day 8 → ALT day 10
Restart ART 2 weeks after rechallenge complete
Integrated TB / ART script; clinic date for ART start or review
No longer infectious after 2 weeks of treatment

items.t: 25 mg daily (neuropathy: 50–75 mg, up to 200 mg if HIV+)
Cotrimoxazole 960 mg (160/800) daily — all HIV + TB, regardless of CD4
eGFR < 30: IP = RH (Tue, Thu, Sat, Sun) + RHZE (Mon, Wed, Fri); CP RH daily
CD4 < 50: start ART within 2 weeks of TB treatment, once improving and tolerating
CD4 ≥ 50: start ART 8 weeks after TB treatment starts
Cryptococcal meningitis: defer until 4–6 weeks of antifungal (REFER)
TLD 1 tab daily + DTG 50 mg 12 h later (DTG boosting on rifampicin)
eGFR ≤ 50: ABC + 3TC + DTG (ALD) instead of TLD, + DTG 50 mg 12 h later
ART-naïve alternative: EFV-based regimen (no rifampicin interaction)
Continue DTG boosting until 2 weeks after rifampicin stops
On TLD / DTG: add DTG 50 mg 12 h after TLD
On EFV and suppressed: continue EFV until 2 weeks after TB treatment, then switch to DTG
On ATV/r or DRV/r: rifampicin cannot be given — HIV & TB hotline 0800 212 506
CD4 ≤ 100 and < 30 days of TB treatment when ART starts: prednisone 40 mg daily × 2 weeks, then 20 mg × 2 weeks (not if Kaposi sarcoma)
New fever / nodes / worse chest after ART
Paradoxical IRIS: continue TB drugs and ART; exclude RR-TB, non-adherence, new OI
Severe (compression, CNS): prednisone 1.5 mg/kg daily × 2 weeks, then 0.75 mg/kg × 2 weeks
Hepatitis (ALT > 5 × ULN, or lower with jaundice / symptoms): stop R, H, Z (and ART, CPT)

discharge.title: Discharge criteria — all six must be met

items.t: Tolerating TB drugs + CPT (+ ART if started)
CD4, CrAg, Xpert results actioned; notified
ART start date or boosting plan written
One clinician manages TB and ART together (fewer visits, less LTFU)
ART start at week 8 if CD4 ≥ 50 (date: ____)
TB review 2 weeks, then monthly; smear at 7 and 23 weeks
VL 3 months after ART start / re-engagement
Stop DTG boosting 2 weeks after rifampicin ends; contacts: TPT for < 5 y and HIV+
